declarations.callText:
it("includes titleField and dateField on the response contract", () => {
		const result = collectionSchema.parse({
			id: "col_1",
			slug: "import_runs",
			label: "Import runs",
			labelSingular: null,
			description: null,
			icon: null,
			supports: ["drafts"],
			source: null,
			urlPattern: null,
			routable: true,
			hasSeo: false,
			hidden: false,
			sortOrder: null,
			editLocking: true,
			createdAt: "2026-08-20T00:00:00Z",
			updatedAt: "2026-08-20T00:00:00Z",
			titleField: "run_status",
			dateField: "started_at",
		});
		expect(result.titleField).toBe("run_status");
		expect(result.dateField).toBe("started_at");
	})

dependencyClosure.workspaceBuiltExportsResolution: Package export dist entries are mapped to their pinned src counterparts only when that complete source path exists. Pinned tsdown configs for admin/auth/blocks are retained as authorities; generated package artefacts are not invented.

execution.status: Unapplied test-only proposal. All original concurrent-index callbacks and development-bypass E2E callbacks are preserved and unregistered pending exact execution scope qualification. Entire families are retained; no callback is selectively removed.

fieldMenu.fourteenPresenceRegexes: Whole original constant and loop are retained. Presence is not a size limit; actual Source menu and all 17 Native storage types remain authoritative.

dependencies.search: Single existing SchemaRegistry and FTSManager owner; real flags/hooks and search index plans coordinated with search owner.
dependencies.blocks: Only actual public Main after block91/provider15 lands; listBlockTypes returns complete versions inventory. No private runtime adoption.
